# Reference typography

The exact font in the supplied screenshot cannot be established from raster pixels alone. DM Serif Display was selected as the closest heading treatment, with DM Sans for Latin body text. Korean text uses S-Core Dream as requested. These are locally hosted font files, not remote CSS dependencies.

- DM Sans / DM Serif Display: https://github.com/googlefonts/dm-fonts and https://github.com/google/fonts. Original SIL Open Font License files are included separately for both families.
- S-Core Dream: copyright S-Core Co., Ltd. Files are unchanged from https://github.com/fonts-archive/S-CoreDream. The upstream README, including redistribution notice, is included as S-Core-Dream-README.md.
- The matte hair-photo stage was sampled from the supplied reference: RGB(231, 227, 224), #e7e3e0.
